title: Xtra Power High Torque Screw Driver Bit, 65 mm
description: Xtra Power High Torque Screw Driver Bit, 65 mm - Distributed/Packaged by Xtra Power. Product Details: This high torque screw driver bit is engineered for demanding fastening applications where standard bits fall short. Measuring 2.5 inches (65 mm) in length, this fastener drive bit delivers exceptional power transfer and durability when working with stubborn screws and bolts. The high torque design ensures optimal grip and reduces cam-out, allowing you to tackle tough jobs with confidence. Whether you're working with power drills, impact drivers, or manual screwdrivers, this bit provides the strength and reliability professionals and DIY enthusiasts need. The 65 mm length offers excellent reach into recessed areas whilst maintaining stability during operation. Built to withstand repeated high-stress use, this screw driver bit is an essential addition to any toolkit for construction, automotive repair, furniture assembly, or general maintenance tasks. The precision-engineered tip ensures secure engagement with fastener heads, minimising wear on both the bit and the screw.
